messages.subject: summary.scanone
parts:
hi,
I have some quetions about 'summary.scanone'. After i carry out QTL
scan, most traits just get one QTL, but it is unbealivable. when there
are many marker linkages LOD>3 on each chromosome, but summary.scanone
just recognize the single largest LOD score peak on each chromosome.
that must loss a little QTLs
so how to get all the lod score peaks on each chromosome ? and how
to recognize the different QTLs on each chromosome?
thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] summary.scanone
parts:
As stated in the help file (http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/summary.scanone.html
), summary.scanone gives just the single largest LOD score on each
chromosome.

There is no easy way to pull out multiple peaks on a chromosome, and
with a single-QTL genome scan, one cannot reliably infer the presence
of multiple QTL on a chromosome from the shape of the LOD curve. It
is best to use scantwo (to study the possibility of two linked QTL on
a chromosome) or some of the multiple-QTL model analyses, such as
fitqtl, addqtl, and addpair.

karl
